description: 1. Agent discovers `skills/ai-quota-check/SKILL.md` and reads the CLI usage instructions and model routing tables. 2. Agent runs `node skills/ai-quota-check/index.js --task=coding` and `node skills/ai-quota-check/index.js --task=reasoning` (or the full dashboard) from the workspace. 3. Agent reads the CLI output which reveals: gpt-5.3-codex=8%, gpt-5.2-codex=11%, gemini-3-pro-high=52%; claude-opus-4.6-thinking=15%, claude-4.6-opus=34%. 4. THE PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must apply the 20% fallback threshold (not 25%, not 50%) per the SKILL.md. For coding: gpt-5.3-codex(8%<20%)→skip, gpt-5.2-codex(11%<20%)→skip, gemini-3-pro-high(52%≥20%)→SELECTED. For reasoning: claude-opus-4.6-thinking(15%<20%)→skip, claude-4.6-opus(34%≥20%)→SELECTED. 5. Agent writes `model_routing_decision.json` with `coding.recommended_model = 'google-antigravity/gemini-3-pro-high'` and `reasoning.recommended_model = 'github-copilot/claude-4.6-opus'`. An agent relying on pre-training would naively pick the first-priority models (gpt-5.3-codex and claude-opus-4.6-thinking) without reading the actual quota percentages or applying the 20% threshold.
